entities.name: Richard III of England
entities.label: Person
entities.summary:
Richard III of England (1452–1485) was the last Plantagenet king of England, ruling from June 1483 until his death at Bosworth Field. He governed the North, then took the throne after the disappearance of Edward V and Richard of York—the Princes in the Tower—events that permanently stained his reputation.

His brief reign combined legal reform and northern affinity politics with a contested succession that invited Henry Tudor’s invasion. Defeat at Bosworth ended the Wars of the Roses’

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Richard III's contested succession led to the rise of the Tudor dynasty and the end of the Wars of the Roses.
